summaries.objective: Verify the Vitals module supports the primary action described by the requirement and records an audit log entry when it completes.
summaries.verifies: verifies nominal completion of the primary action in the Vitals module and creation of an audit log entry
protocol: Log in to the HealthCore EHR test environment with an appropriate role; keep the Vitals module active.
Execute the primary action specified in the requirement.
Verify the system response and state change.
acceptance_criteria: An audit log entry is created.

summaries.objective: Verify the Vitals module detects invalid input and blocks submission of the action.
summaries.verifies: verifies rejection of invalid or malformed input and blocking of the submitted action
protocol: Use the HealthCore EHR test environment with the Vitals module active.
acceptance_criteria: System validates input and detects an error.
An appropriate error message is displayed.

summaries.objective: Verify the Vitals module handles a boundary value at the specified threshold or edge case.
summaries.verifies: verifies system behavior for a boundary value in the Vitals module per specification
protocol: Use the HealthCore EHR test environment with the Vitals module active.
Test at the threshold or boundary value.
Verify system behavior at the edge case.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary value is accepted or rejected appropriately.
System handles the edge case correctly per specification.

summaries.objective: Verify that executing the required action results in an audit log entry that includes the specified fields.
summaries.verifies: verifies creation of an audit log entry after the action completes and presence of the listed fields in that entry
protocol: Use the HealthCore EHR test environment with the audit log viewer open.
Execute the action specified in the requirement.
Query the audit log for recent entries.
Verify the log entry contains the required fields.
acceptance_criteria: Log entry includes timestamp, user ID, action type, and outcome.
